# Shope Concrete

> Shope Concrete Products is a Western Washington manufacturer and wholesale distributor of precast concrete pipe, manholes, catch basins, and other related concrete products, serving contractors since 1947.

## About

Shope Concrete is located in Puyallup, WA and serves local, state, federal, and regional contractors throughout Western Washington. Products are used in underground infrastructure for residential communities, urban developments, streets, roads, and freeways.

## Products

- Concrete Pipe: 12" to 96" diameter reinforced concrete pipe (RCP) for drainage and sanitary sewer systems.
- Catch Basins: WSDOT Type 1, Type 1-L, Type 1-P, Type 2, Type 15, Type 30, Type 40, Type 50, and custom configurations.
- Manholes: WSDOT Type 1, Type 2, Type 3 in 48", 54", 60", 72", 84", and 96" diameters.
- Maintenance Holes: City of Seattle Standard Plans (Type 204a–f), City of Tacoma standard plans.
- Area Drains: Type 18, Type 45 in 12", 18", and 24" sizes.
- Miscellaneous Precast: Grade rings, grade ring risers, parking bumpers, wheel stops, curb stops, trench drains, flow spreaders, monuments, hydrant guard posts, and grease interceptors.
- Custom Precast: Vaults, barriers, and specialized structural components.

## Service Area

Western Washington including King, Pierce, Snohomish, Kitsap, Thurston, and surrounding counties.

## Certifications

NPCA (National Precast Concrete Association) Plant Certified.
